records.text: A command-level UVU police official told security that the roof area was covered, leaving Brian Harpole with nothing further to do.
records.speaker: Brian Harpole

appearances.snippet: He comes back and his last correspondence was, I got you covered. ... What else am I to do when a command level person from an accredited police department says, I've got this area?

verification.notes: Harpole publicly made this account and displayed a text exchange in which UVU Police Chief Jeff Long told the private security team that police had the roof area covered. This verifies the communication claim at medium confidence; it does not establish that coverage was actually effective.

sources.title: UVU police chief promised to secure roofs, says Charlie Kirks contracted security
sources.relevance: Reports the displayed text exchange and Harpole account that Chief Jeff Long said police had the roof area covered.

sources.title: Brian Harpole - Groundbreaking Evidence From Charlie Kirks Head of Security | SRS #254
